goal: Defend or reject the claim that an explanation of the obtaining contingent sequence cannot be completed solely by further contingent members whose own obtaining remains unexplained. Evaluate the whole-series sufficient-reason norm and whether a non-well-founded global structural account can meet it; do not stipulate that all explanation is inductively generated. Separately test the proposed necessary ground’s intrinsic sufficiency and actuality.
reason: The read §§36–37 supplies an explicit argument for explanatory deferment, while existing unique-feedback/history-contrastive/regress certificates do not choose its adequacy norm. Mathematical uniqueness does not by itself explain why its constraint system obtains; conversely, saying an account is infinite does not show that a stronger global account leaves that fact unexplained. The source claim is not an automatic inference from epistemic Agrippa skepticism to causal impossibility. See docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md.
